title: Deterministic synthetic data generators
acceptance: generatePolicies({tenantId,lob,count,seed,state}) returns PolicySnapshot-valid objects (required fields from the schema checked in tests) for auto, home, commercial_auto; same seed gives deep-equal output, different seed differs
VINs are 17 chars with valid check digit (tested)

SCENARIOS contains at least the 8 named scenarios; generateScenario returns {name,lob,lossType,intakeAnswers,claimCreate,documents,expected} with expected {coverageStatus,severityBand,fraud,subrogation,fastTrack}, deterministic per seed
Police report and repair estimate documents contain realistic text with line items; no real carrier names or people; zero dependencies
brief: Create tests/synthetic/index.mjs exporting generatePolicies, SCENARIOS, generateScenario (keep the signatures exactly), plus helpers in tests/synthetic/ (prng.mjs seeded mulberry32 or similar, names.mjs, vin.mjs, documents.mjs) and tests in tests/synthetic/*.test.mjs. Never use Math.random or Date.now; all dates derive from seed with effective periods around 2026. Read PolicySnapshot.schema.json and common.schema.json and make outputs satisfy required fields and enums; write a tiny local validator in the test (required keys, types, enums) rather than adding dependencies. LOBs: auto, home, commercial_auto (check the schema enum for exact lob names and use those). Coverages/limits/deductibles realistic per LOB (e.g. auto 100/300/100 BI/PD, collision deductible 500; home dwelling A, water deductible 1000; fleet of 5-10 units for commercial). Tenant question ids: if tenants/*.json exist, read them at generation time (optional, fs read guarded by try/catch) and key intakeAnswers by their question ids; otherwise use generic keys (lossDate, lossDescription, injuries, policeReportNumber, drivable, etc.). claimCreate must match ClaimCreate in openapi.yaml. Scenarios: auto_rear_end_injury (subrogation true, fastTrack false, severity medium/high), auto_glass_only (fastTrack true), auto_theft_late_report (fraud true, report days after loss), auto_hit_and_run, home_water_small (fastTrack true, under 2500 estimate), home_fire_large (severity high/total), home_loss_before_inception (loss date before policy effective date, coverageStatus not_in_force; check CoverageVerification schema for exact enum), commercial_auto_fleet_collision. Documents: police report text (report no., parties, narrative, citations) and repair estimate text (line items parts/labor/tax/total that sum correctly), with kind/filename/contentType/text and optional metadata; include one tiny base64 image placeholder. Optionally put static JSON samples in tests/fixtures/. All names, carriers and addresses fictional (use reserved-like phone 555-01xx).

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met; 20/20 tests pass, deterministic, valid VINs, 8 scenarios, fictional data, zero deps, in-scope paths only
